notice: DEMO INPUT images. The investigations they trigger are fully live -- only the starting image is pre-selected. Add your own entries here; each needs a public_url for discovery to be possible.

examples.title: Public figure
examples.description: A head of government. Widely published, so reverse image search finds genuine matches across many independent news domains -- the case where corroboration is meaningful.
examples.attribution: Official / press photograph of a public figure.

preflight.note: Input verified: URL reachable, image decodable, face usable. Discovery RESULTS are not guaranteed -- they depend on a third-party index.

examples.title: Low web presence
examples.description: A private individual with almost no indexed presence. Discovery returns visually similar strangers and verification rejects all of them -- the case that proves the firewall works.
examples.attribution: Operator's own photograph, used with consent.

preflight.note: No public URL. This example can be previewed and analysed locally but cannot be used for public discovery.
